<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on the known explanation that when one judges another, he judges himself, the Mitteler Rebbe's ruling on "Padeh BeShalom" applies to his own redemption of 10 Kislev, where the opponent is nullified and even turned into a friend.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to the known [explanation]</t>
    <t s="1">in the interpretation of the statement of our sages, of blessed memory,</t>
    <t s="2">"A person is punished with his knowledge and without his knowledge,"</t>
    <t s="3">(and similarly in the interpretation of the wording of the Mishnah,</t>
    <t s="4">"judgment and accounting"),</t>
    <t s="5">that when a person states the verdict of another person, he thereby also judges himself,</t>
    <t s="6">behold, the verdict of the Mitteler Rebbe in his maamar beginning "Padeh BeShalom nafshi,"</t>
    <t s="7">that the interpretation of "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" is that the opponent is nullified</t>
    <t s="8">(like the peace that was in the days of Shlomo),</t>
    <t s="9">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="10">that the opponent is turned into a friend</t>
    <t s="11">(like the peace that will be in the future),</t>
    <t s="12">is a verdict also regarding the matter of "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" in his redemption — the redemption of 10 Kislev,</t>
    <t s="13">[and from this it is understood also regarding the matter of "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" in the redemption of 19 Kislev and in the redemption of 12 Tammuz],</t>
    <t s="14">that the matter of peace in these redemptions is that the opponent is nullified,</t>
    <t s="15">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="16">that he is turned into a friend.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The simple meaning of "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" refers to Dovid's redemption in this world, and the connection to the maamar's interpretation about the future is explained through the Rambam's teaching that Dovid is the first Mashiach, initiating what the final Mashiach will complete, so Dovid's redemption already contained the peace internally.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, the simple interpretation of the verse "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" is,</t>
    <t s="2">that Dovid said this regarding his redemption as it is in this world,</t>
    <t s="3">that this redemption is in peace.</t>
    <t s="4">And one must understand the connection and relevance of the interpretation in the maamar, that this which Dovid said "Padeh BeShalom nafshi" refers to the soul of Dovid as it will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="5">with the simple interpretation that Dovid's redemption at that time was a redemption in peace.</t>
    <t s="6">And one can say the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="7">based on what the Rambam wrote,</t>
    <t s="8">that in the portion of Bilaam it speaks of two messiahs,</t>
    <t s="9">the first messiah who is Dovid and the final messiah who will stand from his descendants.</t>
    <t s="10">And one can say,</t>
    <t s="11">that the reason that Dovid is called by the name "first messiah" is,</t>
    <t s="12">that all the matters that will be through the King Mashiach</t>
    <t s="13">(the final messiah),</t>
    <t s="14">their beginning was through Dovid,</t>
    <t s="15">the first messiah.</t>
    <t s="16">Only that the completion and perfection of them will be through the final messiah who stands from the descendants of Dovid.</t>
    <t s="17">And based on this, one can explain the connection of the two interpretations in the verse "Padeh BeShalom nafshi,"</t>
    <t s="18">that in innerness,</t>
    <t s="19">also the redemption of Dovid at that time was a redemption in peace.</t>
    <t s="20">That is, the opponents were nullified</t>
    <t s="21">(and not only that they did not fight with him)</t>
    <t s="22">and furthermore, they were turned into friends.</t>
    <t s="23">Only that by Dovid this was in innerness and in concealment,</t>
    <t s="24">and in the future the innerness of the redemption of the soul of Dovid will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="25">which is a redemption in peace.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on this, the greatness of the 10 Kislev redemption is further understood, as it is called a redemption in peace, indicating that the nullification of the opponent and his transformation into a friend were revealed.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, the greatness of the elevation of the redemption of 10 Kislev will be understood even more,</t>
    <t s="1">that from the fact that they say about it that it is a redemption in peace</t>
    <t s="2">(without adding the explanation that it is a preparation for the "Padeh BeShalom" of the future,</t>
    <t s="3">and the like),</t>
    <t s="4">it is proven,</t>
    <t s="5">that the matter of peace within it</t>
    <t s="6">[that the opponent is nullified,</t>
    <t s="7">and furthermore, that he is turned into a friend]</t>
    <t s="8">is</t>
    <t s="9">(also)</t>
    <t s="10">in revelation.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
